name: smarthealth
description: Atalhos para rodar o SmartHealth inteiro (Postgres, cnes-service, api-gateway e app) com um comando

scripts.setup: npm install && npm --prefix services/cnes-service install && npm --prefix services/api-gateway install && npm --prefix app install
scripts.dev:api: npm run db && npm run dev:api:servicos
scripts.dev:api:servicos: concurrently --names cnes,gateway --prefix-colors blue,magenta "npm --prefix services/cnes-service run dev" "npm --prefix services/api-gateway run dev"
